name: Majority Defect Is Unbounded on Rank-Two Maximum Classes
statement: The majority completion defect is unbounded on maximum classes of VC dimension two: for $L_{n,2}=\{S\subseteq[n]:|S|\leq2\}$, $\delta_{\mathrm{med}}(L_{n,2})=2^n-1-n-\binom n2$.
proof: Every unary and binary pattern occurs in $L_{n,2}$, so the binary-pattern theorem makes its majority closure the whole cube. Subtracting the maximum-class size $1+n+\binom n2$ gives the formula.
